## What's new

**Virtual AI cursor OFF switch (Settings ΓåÆ PC control and safety)**
- New toggle **Virtual AI cursor** under *While ABxAG works*. Turn it off and every AI click stays on your physical mouse ΓÇö guaranteed, enforced in the backend before any agent call.
- OFF hides the red overlay cursor completely; it comes back the moment you re-enable. Pause (Ctrl+Alt+P) always stays available.
- If the AI hits the OFF switch mid-task, it tells you plainly and continues with the physical mouse instead of retrying.

**Auto-update repaired**
- Fixed: on networks where api.github.com 404s, the updater fell back to the mirror feed but parsed it as blank versions with no installers ΓÇö so it wrongly said *up-to-date* and old versions showed nothing to install. The mirror shape is now parsed properly (all 13 releases show with installers), and unknown feed shapes fail loudly instead of faking *up-to-date*.
- After installing this version once, auto-update and switching to any older version work on their own.

## Fixed
- Virtual cursor could not be turned off at all ΓÇö fixed with a real kill switch (setting + backend gate + overlay hide).
- Auto-update silent *up-to-date* lie on restricted networks ΓÇö fixed + regression tests.
- Verified: tsc clean, 78 agent + 8 character + 43 Python tests green, portable smoke test passed (96 agent tools, kill-switch toggled live OFFΓåÆON).

**Note:** PC agent bundle unchanged (no runtime tool change); installer carries the same 96-tool agent.

## What's new ΓÇö Dual-Cursor actually works now

The virtual (AI) mouse existed in v1.1.12 but never visibly worked. This release wires it end to end:

**New**
- AI knows the virtual pointer: 11 virtual tool declarations for the task engine (virtualMove/Click/RightClick/DoubleClick/Type/Scroll/Inspect/Find/UiAction, pause/resumeVirtual) + a DUAL-CURSOR rule ΓÇö when you may be at the PC, ABxAG uses the virtual cursor that never touches your physical mouse.
- Live neon AI cursor: the red overlay cursor now follows the AI in real time (1/s backend poll) with an Active/Idle/Paused pill showing its current task.
- Ctrl+Alt+P now really pauses/resumes the AI backend (previously overlay display only).
- New local endpoint GET /api/virtual-cursor with the live virtual-cursor state.
- CI workflow: every push to DEV now runs tsc lint, Electron syntax checks and all 43 Python agent tests automatically.

**Fixed**
- AI always stole the physical mouse (it had no virtual declarations) ΓÇö fixed, it now prefers background UIA + window-message actions.
- Overlay cursor frozen at (500,400) ΓÇö fixed, it glides to whatever the AI touches.
- Pause hotkey desync between overlay and backend ΓÇö fixed.
- Verified: tsc clean, 72 agent + 8 character + 43 Python tests green, portable smoke test (96 agent tools incl. all 12 virtual) passed.

**Note:** PC agent bundle unchanged since v1.1.12 (no runtime tool change), installer carries the same 96-tool agent.
Dual-cursor: the AI gets its own neon on-screen pointer (UIA + background clicks) while your physical mouse stays 100% yours. Pause anytime with Ctrl+Alt+P.
Full companion control: backflip, dance and every stage move on the desktop doll via companionPerform. Outfit tint touches real clothes only.
Per-doll outfit colors: main stage and desktop companion can each keep their own color. Outfit tint now touches real clothes only (skin/face never dyed).
Character autonomy: she performs body moves on request (jump, wave, dance...), changes character by voice or by herself when long idle, and recolors her outfit on request.
Every surface shows ABxAG now: runtime exe re-stamped (no more Electron name/icon in Task Manager and taskbar), icon fallback hardening.
Truly silent auto-update: no more Choose-Options / Install-Location clicks. Portable and dev builds keep the guided installer.
Coughs and breaths no longer stop her mid-sentence: interrupting takes sustained speech now. Plus a Voice setting to turn interruption on/off.
Auto-install countdown after download + re-prompt when a background download finishes. No more silent stuck updates.
Fixes the 'hit a problem and is reloading' crash loop (task results rendered safely + regression test). Every finished task used to crash the UI.

Update checker mirror fallback (works where api.github.com is blocked), update reminder popup with daily repeat + auto-update switch, /download page with bundled release list. Removes leftover dev scratch file.
About links (abxag.absup.dev + mirror) and in-app updates: auto/manual mode plus one-click switch between any versions, old or new.
First public release. Private 3D AI desktop companion for Windows. Bring your own free Gemini API key, import any .pmx/.pmd/.vrm/.glb/.fbx/.obj character.
